mistakes.questionText: Discuss the mechanism of catalytic hydrogenation of alk-1-enes using Wilkinson Catalyst at $25^{\circ}\text{C}$ and 1 atmp pressure.
mistakes.userAnswer: The alkene then binds to the rhodium center via $\pi$-complexation. This is followed by a migratory insertion of the alkene into one of the Rh-H bonds to form an alkyl intermediate. Finally, a reductive elimination step couples the alkyl group with the remaining hydride, releasing the hydrogenated alkane product and regenerating the active rhodium(I) catalyst species.
